summary: Draw It In, rebuilt Klein-only: crop, edit, stitch - no render phase, no paste, no mask

Context measurement DONE, 7 Klein 9B runs on a 75px scribble. Governing variable is scribble px after 1MP normalise, not the extend factor: threshold ~200px, crop_MP <= (scribble_px/200)^2, sweet spot ~243px. Law 1 does NOT transfer (no blown-out patch at any rung incl 1x). Failure is at the WIDE end and is anchoring, not legibility; whole-image is destructive (deleted the woman, fused the tiger into the man). No absolute minimum drawn size - the crop manufactures resolution, so the 96px ControlNet ink floor does not carry over.
